description: Core events, the pane commands, the folder picker the target chooser needs, the two window writes that restore a saved size/position on launch, and the drag the overlay title bar needs to move the window. One window, so one label. WP-15's second window was also listed here, because capabilities are scoped by label and a window missing from this list gets no `invoke` and no `listen` at all — a terminal that can never spawn or receive a byte, with no error to say why. D-073 removed that window: the evaluator is a view inside `main` and inherits this capability rather than needing its own.
